# Image Evaluator
> 生产级多维图像生成评测工具库，覆盖美学质量、语义对齐、主体保真、成对失真、分布差异与人类偏好 9 大核心评测指标。

## 文档索引
- [Quickstart](/): Lightweight unified evaluation toolkit for generative image quality and alignment
- [Task Selection Guide](/guides/task-selection): Metric decision trees, scenario applicability boundaries, and common misuse anti-patterns across generative vision tasks.
- [Batch Evaluation & Performance Best Practices](/guides/batch-performance): Quantitative comparison of invocation modalities, model residency mechanisms, and standard code paradigms for high-throughput batch evaluation.
- [Aesthetic Score](/no-reference/aesthetic): LAION aesthetic predictor using OpenCLIP ViT-L-14 visual embeddings and linear projection
- [CLIP Score](/text-image/clip): Text-to-image cross-modal semantic cosine alignment using CLIP ViT-B/32
- [Directional CLIP](/text-image/directional-clip): Relative semantic direction alignment for image editing using CLIP embedding differences
- [PickScore](/text-image/pickscore): Fine-tuned CLIP ViT-H-14 human preference reward scoring trained on the Pick-a-Pic benchmark
- [LPIPS (Perceptual Distance)](/pairwise/lpips): Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity using AlexNet multi-scale deep features
- [SSIM (Structural Similarity)](/pairwise/ssim): Structural Similarity Index Measure computed across luminance, contrast, and structure
- [PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio)](/pairwise/psnr): Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (dB) computed from pixel-wise Mean Squared Error
- [ArcFace Distance](/pairwise/arcface): Facial identity preservation using InsightFace buffalo_l 512-dimensional cosine feature distance
- [FID (Fréchet Inception Distance)](/distribution/fid): Generative distribution distance evaluated in Inception-v3 pool3 feature space
- [KID (Kernel Inception Distance)](/distribution/kid): Unbiased polynomial kernel maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in Inception feature space
- [Visual Benchmark (Interactive Demo)](/benchmark/visual-demo): Interactive multi-metric dashboard and dual-image slider comparative inspection

## 命令行使用范例
```bash
# 1. 单图视觉美学评分
image-evaluator --metrics aesthetic --image path/to/sample.png

# 2. 图文对齐与人类偏好评分
image-evaluator --metrics clip pickscore \
    --image path/to/sample.png \
    --prompt "a photograph of an astronaut riding a horse on mars"

# 3. 成对图像保真度评估 (LPIPS, SSIM, PSNR)
image-evaluator --metrics lpips ssim psnr \
    --image path/to/generated.png \
    --reference path/to/reference.png

# 4. 数据集分布距离评测 (FID, KID)
image-evaluator --metrics fid kid \
    --image path/to/generated_folder/ \
    --reference path/to/real_folder/

```
